headline: Explore for free. Add analysis. Add AI.
intro: SpaceAware brings satellites, Earth, weather and the solar system into one workspace. Start with free data and exploration, add tools for sensors and advanced analysis, then add AI. SpaceEdge brings space combat and UDL access to government programs.
dataRule: Capabilities that use free data belong in Free. Public data views, imagery, weather, stars and source-based results stay available without a subscription or sign-in, with their attribution and usage terms. Paying for a plan does not change those terms. Every source carries one rights class, below.

general.title: General-purpose rights
general.text: Free for any use, commercial included, with the credit each source asks. Share-alike sources require derived records to carry the same terms.

non-commercial.title: Non-commercial rights only
non-commercial.text: Free for non-commercial use only. Shown signed out and free; no plan sells them.

results.title: Results only
results.text: Used to compute results and cited by name. The records themselves are never republished.

plans.name: Free
plans.summary: See what is happening in space and on Earth.
includes: Live satellite catalog, search and object information
Earth and planetary imagery, terrain and maps
Weather with 4K clouds and space weather, from free sources
Stars, galaxies, the Moon and the solar system
Public orbit products and source-based results
Free data under general-purpose or non-commercial rights, each with its credit (listed below)
plans.example: Look up a satellite, explore the Moon or follow a storm.

plans.name: Analysis
plans.summary: Add sensors and advanced analysis to everything in Free.
includes: Sensor placement, coverage and observation planning
Custom conjunction and uncertainty studies
Orbit fitting and advanced propagation studies
Maneuver, rendezvous and ground-contact planning
Radio links, interference and network analysis
High-definition weather clouds
plans.example: Compare where to place a sensor and when it can see an object.

plans.name: AI
plans.summary: Add AI to everything in Analysis.
includes: AI assistance in the workspace
AI-assisted analysis workflows
AI object detection in imagery
All sensors and advanced analysis in the $5 plan
plans.example: Use AI to help investigate a scene or identify objects in imagery.

plans.name: SpaceEdge
plans.summary: Add space combat and UDL access to the SpaceAware capability set.
includes: Space combat scenarios and analysis
Unified Data Library (UDL) access
The customer's authorized data and permissions
Deployment and support scoped to the program
plans.example: Bring a program's authorized UDL data into its mission workspace.

capabilities.name: Satellites and public orbit data
capabilities.description: Find objects, inspect their orbits and follow published results.

capabilities.name: Earth, weather and space weather
capabilities.description: Explore imagery, terrain, 4K clouds, forecasts and solar activity from free sources.

capabilities.name: Stars and the solar system
capabilities.description: Explore the Moon, planets, stars and nearby galaxies.

capabilities.name: Sensors
capabilities.description: Plan sensor locations, coverage and observations.

capabilities.name: Advanced analysis
capabilities.description: Run custom orbit, maneuver, conjunction, communications and uncertainty studies.

capabilities.name: High-definition weather clouds
capabilities.description: See the weather as high-definition clouds. The 4K clouds stay in Free.

capabilities.name: AI
capabilities.description: Add AI assistance and AI analysis, including imagery object detection.

capabilities.name: Space combat
capabilities.description: Program-specific space combat scenarios and analysis.

capabilities.name: UDL
capabilities.description: Connect authorized government data through the customer's UDL account.

talkingPoints.title: Start with what the customer wants to do
talkingPoints.text: Explore data: Free. Plan sensors or run advanced studies: Analysis. Work with AI: AI. Space combat or UDL: SpaceEdge.

talkingPoints.title: Keep the data free
talkingPoints.text: Free and non-commercial data capabilities stay in Free. Paid plans add software tools and workflows; they do not sell access to those datasets or expand their usage rights.

talkingPoints.title: Use the right product name
talkingPoints.text: SpaceAware is the workspace. Space Data Network carries data and software. OrbPro is the visualization engine. SpaceEdge is the government offering.
